name: Moonbow #112 1g Pre-Roll
description: Lineage: Zkittlez x Do-Si-Dos Terpenes: Caryophyllene, Limonene, Myrcene Effects: Relaxed, Focused, Creative, Social Aroma: Pepper, Sweet, Earthy Strap in, space cadet, and prepare to boldly go where no taste bud has gone before! With Moonbow as your trusty cosmic guide, each inhale is like a launchpad, propelling you into a multi-dimensional experience that's so mind-bending, even Einstein would raise an eyebrow. Beam yourself to flavor town and get ready for a trip that's both out of this world, and right on the funny bone.
